metadata.title: APERÇU SYSTÉMATIQUE DES COMBINAISONS DITES INORGANIQUES

typographie_suggestion.explanation: The main titles ("APERÇU SYSTÉMATIQUE" and "COMBINAISONS DITES INORGANIQUES") feature heavy, block-like serifs with little to no bracketing, which is characteristic of the Slab Serif style popular in 19th-century printing.
